column3: Settled midpack early - shifted wide and began closing from 2f out - powered through inside the final furlong - hit the front close to home - drew clear at the finish
Handy with the front pack early - nudged into the advantage entering the final furlong before being overtaken close home - unable to find more and held for second
Went straight into front spot early - lost the advantage entering final furlong - stayed on without finding more late to finish third
Raced close to the pace - holding a strong claim entering the final furlong - lost placings in the closing stages to finish fourth beaten 2.5 lengths
Held up in the pack - closed a bit approaching the last furlong - stayed on to finish fifth beaten 2¾ lengths
Held up towards the back - pushed along a furlong out then found a bit close home - finished 6th
Settled last early - roused to close ground inside final furlong - stayed on to finish seventh
Settled in second early - driven and dropped back over 1f out - faded fast close home - finished eighth
Settled in the pack - lost touch a furlong out - dropped away close home - eventually finished ninth
Held up towards the back - unable to quicken from over 1f out - beaten into last approaching the final furlong and well held at the line
Settled towards the back - boxed in with a furlong left - found space and finished strongly - hit the front inside the final 110yds to score
Shared front role early - edged in front approaching 3f - driven forward with a furlong left - overtaken close home - stayed on to snatch second
Settled in the pack early - slipped towards the back with over two furlongs to run - responded to urging inside the final furlong to finish strongly - grabbed third spot right on the line
Settled just behind the front group early - moved into third with a furlong left - unable to match the two in front through the closing stages - eased back to finish fourth close home
Held up at the back - progress wide of rivals over 2f out - pushed along inside the final furlong to stay on for 5th
Dwelt at the break - settled towards the back - made progress out wide from over a furlong out and threatened to get involved inside the final furlong - lost ground near the line to finish sixth
Held handy early - urged into second spot approaching final furlong before losing that spot quickly - dropped away to finish seventh
Drifted right whole way - shared front spot early - settled just behind leader after 2f - urged into effort over 2f out - dropped away fast inside final furlong - finished eighth
Sat handy in behind the front pack - moved into second with two furlongs left - pushed along as straight approached and hit the front a furlong out - kept finding more to the line for the win

Settled in the pack - pulled hard in the early stages - nudged forward after 6f - up with the front rank at halfway - moved through to hit the front 2f out - soon under pressure and lost advantage 1f out - plugged on at one speed to finish second
Held up at the back of the field - improved into 4th 3f out under pressure - up to 4th place a furlong out - stayed on late to finish 3rd
Sat handy behind the pace - pushed along into 3rd approaching final 2f - held that spot with little more to give - edged back to finish 4th
Sat second early - moved up front with 6f left - pressed for effort inside final 2f but lost front spot and faded to finish 5th
Held up at rear throughout - nudged along after 6f and lost touch with the field - crept into 7th 3f out but made no further headway - well held in 6th
Held up towards the back - pushed along in 6th with 3f left - unable to close - well held in 7th
Went straight to the front - lost the advantage 6f out and soon under pressure fading rapidly - dropped right out to finish last of eight

Settled towards the back of the field early - improved on the outside to strike front before 2 out - pushed clear approaching 4 out then driven along past 3 out - came under pressure from a rival 2 out - drifted left approaching the final flight but battled on gamely - edged home at the line
Sat close to the front group early - moved into second three out under pressure - kept battling to the line and edged out by a short head
Settled midpack early - made headway approaching 3 out then driven into contention to share third before 2 out - held same rhythm to the line finishing third beaten a length and a half
Held up towards the back - driven into contention before 3 out and shared third spot 2 out - stayed on same tempo to finish fourth

Held a midfield position early - dropped away and driven to keep up 4 out - regained momentum before 3 out then involved in the fight for third 2 out - blundered at the last and dropped away to finish fifth
Sat close to the pace early - urged forward approaching 3 out - kept battling on despite a mistake 2 out - held throughout to finish sixth
Slow to settle and needed urging near the back - improved into contention by the 6th - driven up to challenge the leading group before 3 out - dropped away 2 out and finished well held in 7th
Sat close to the pace early - dropped into midfield by the 2nd and pushed along before 3 out - unable to find any headway finishing well held
Set the pace early - lost front spot before the 2nd and settled just behind the new pacesetter - urged forward after the 4th from home - lost ground before 3 out and finished well held
Settled in a forward spot early - slipped into the pack by the 2nd - pressed for effort 3 out but had nothing to offer thereafter - eventually well held in 10th
Held up towards the back - given a squeeze before three out - made no impression - eventually well held in 11th
Settled in the pack - urged forward approaching 3 out - lost touch steadily from there to finish well held in 12th
Settled towards the back - urged along and struggling with three furlongs left - well held at the finish
Sat close up early - slipped to midfield by the 2nd then under pressure before 3 out - dropped away thereafter to finish well held
Settled towards the back of the pack - moved into contention before the 3rd and closed on the front group by the 5th - lost touch with the pace after that - toiling four out and eased to a halt
Settled towards the back early - work needed turning for home before gaining ground approaching the furlong marker - powered through the closing stages - got up close to home to score narrowly
Close order early - into third soon after - urged with a furlong left - surged to the front approaching the final stretch - overtaken again and unable to find more at the line
Held up at back - progress from 1f out and strong finish through middle of track - grabbed third close home
Settled in the pack - moved up to harry the front rank a furlong out - angled right and in contention inside the final 110 yards - found little and fourth
Set the pace early - lost front spot briefly then regained command 2f out - fully extended when overtaken inside the final furlong - faded to finish fifth
Up with the pace - dropped back and off the bridle approaching the final furlong - stayed on to recover some of that deficit late
Settled second early - nudged in front briefly before 1f then lost the advantage inside final 2f - dropped away close home finishing seventh
Settled handy in the pack - lost ground rapidly inside final furlong - dropped away close to the line - finished eighth
Tardy start - held up at the back throughout - dropped out of contention entering the final furlong - well beaten in 9th
Settled towards the back of the pack early - made progress to 4th 3 out and up into 3rd soon after - into 2nd approaching the last under pressure - finished strongly to get up in the final strides

Settled in midfield - jumped errors at the 2nd and 4th - moved through to join the front pair before 2 out looking comfortable - asked for effort and went in front turning into the straight - challenged hard inside the last furlong and edged in front again but held on for second narrowly
Sat handy behind the pace before an error at the 2nd - pushed along in 4th approaching 2 out - error at the last cost more ground - up into 3rd inside the final furlong - stayed on to finish third

Settled just behind pace-setter early - moved through to challenge for top spot before 2 out - pushed along and overtaken entering the straight - held 3rd approaching final obstacle - dropped to 4th under a furlong out and held that spot to finish
Held up at the back - checked in 10th 3 out - pushed along into 7th - up to 5th at the last but held for 5th
Settled midpack early - hit a couple of obstacles along the way then pushed along in 6th two out with no real headway - stayed on that spot to finish sixth
Held up towards the back - improved into 7th three out - pushed along but unable to close down leaders - finished well held in 7th
Held up towards the back - pushed along in 10th two out - unable to close - finished well held in 8th
Went straight to front - pressed for effort before losing command approaching 2 out - dropped away steadily to finish well beaten in 9th
Sat close to the pace early - blundered at the 5th - pushed along and slipped back to 9th three out before fading well held
Held up towards the back - hit the 9th - improving position on the outside 8th - departed 3 out

Up with the leader from the outset - took over after the 4th - pulled well ahead before 3 out and stretched further going to 2 out - value for more than the winning margin having been kept to a canter on the run-in
Held up at the back - urged forward approaching 3 out and kept going - moved into clear second on the run-in
Settled in the pack early - moved up to fourth approaching four out and pressed the front-runner from three out without threatening - eased back a spot on the run to the line
Set the pace early - lost front spot after 4th and settled just behind - came under pressure and faded before 2 out
Held up early - gained ground from four out to reach fourth approaching three out - dropped away before the last and finished well held
Held up towards the back - pushed along three out - unable to find any extra - well held in 6th
Settled in the pack early - improved into third by the 5th before being urged forward - lost touch after 4 out to finish well beaten
Sat close to the front pack early - dropped away and driven out after 4 out - well beaten at the finish
settled mid-pack early - moved up on the front group with 2f left - took control approaching the final furlong - pulled well away for an easy win
Handy early - edged in front inside final furlong under urging before giving up advantage - stayed on for second but no match for winner late
Settled in the pack - progress 2f out - tight for room and no gap over 1f out - ran on into the open but lacked the speed to threaten at the death
mid-pack early - urged for room from 2f out but boxed in without space - stayed on at one gear inside the closing furlong to finish 4th
Handy in the early stages - hit the front two out before being reeled in and put to work approaching the final furlong - then faded quickly
Set the pace early - driven to keep up when overtaken with 2f left - dropped away in the closing stages to finish sixth
Sluggish start - settled at back of field - lost touch in closing stages to finish seventh
Held up near back - slipped to last approaching halfway - drifted off the pace and edged wide 2f out - well held in 8th
Held up towards the back - given encouragement with three furlongs left - lost touch entering the final furlong

Sat behind the front group early - moved into third then second three out - reached the front only for tack to slip and jockey lose stirrups entering the straight - lost the advantage and pushed out at the last but fought back to get up on the line
Settled midpack early - advanced to 4th three out - pressed on for the front turning into the straight - edged in front inside the final furlong and stayed on - caught right at the line for second
Held up at back - still 8th with three furlongs left - improved to 6th and then 4th by the last - closed to 3rd inside the final furlong - stayed on to finish third
Set the pace early - driven and matched by a rival turning for home - fully tested at the final obstacle - overtaken with a furlong left - couldn't find more and finished fourth
Held up towards the back early - given a squeeze for a moment - still 8th with two furlongs left - improved into 5th by the finish holding the effort throughout
Settled midpack early - improved to third two out then pushed into fourth turning in - unable to threaten leaders and beaten into sixth
Sat close to the front pack early - pushed along and slipped back to 7th 3 out - unable to close the gap - held on for 7th
Held up at the back from the off - made no impression on the leading group - well beaten in 8th
Held a forward position early - still in touch in 5th before three out - dropped away steadily to finish ninth
Settled handy early - disputing second place approaching 3 out - came down there

Held up towards the back of the field early - made steady progress after four out - up into fourth three out - closed on the front-runner approaching the last - driven to the front on the run-in and drew clear for the win
Held up towards the back - made headway before three out - fifth spot approaching the last - kept on late to snatch second near the line

Settled midfield early - improved into fourth or fifth - upped alongside pace before 3 out and went in front - drifted off a straight line approaching 2 out - blundered at the last - driven and overtaken on the run-in and could find no more finishing third
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along in contention on the run home - lost momentum inside the final furlong - finished fourth
Handy early before going in front approaching the 2nd - asked for effort and lost the advantage 3 out - dropped away to finish fifth
Went straight to the front - lost the advantage approaching the 2nd but stayed in touch - asked for effort before 3 out - faded steadily from there finishing sixth
towards the back of the field - ridden to make progress after 4 out - a long way adrift when fell 3 out
Settled in the pack - urged to keep up after 4 out but dropped away - eased and stopped before 3 out
Up with the front group - jumped poorly at the 5th and dropped back - a long way adrift before 4 out and pulled up before 3 out
Settled in the pack early - made progress into contention 2f out and closed on the front group - powered clear inside final furlong - got up to score close home

Went straight to the front then lost that spot after a furlong - settled back in the pack before halfway - began chipping away at the leaders from 3f out - up into second with 2f left - drifted left approaching the final furlong - regained the advantage inside the last - had nothing more to give and was caught close home
Handy in the early running - hit front on the turn after 2f - given encouragement over 2f out - driven approaching final furlong - overtaken close home - lost ground towards the line

mid-pack early - moved into contention through the first two furlongs and up with the front group - checked and boxed in with a furlong to run - battled on to finish fourth beaten just under six lengths
Handy in the early stages - pushed along with 3f remaining - closed on the front group approaching 2f out - moved right approaching the final furlong and stayed on to finish 5th
Quick progress into second by 2f - pressed for effort with 2f left - checked for room 1f out - lost ground final furlong to finish sixth
Held a middle position early - lost touch with the pace two furlongs out - dropped away inside the final furlong - finished 7th
Settled in the pack early - slipped towards the back before halfway then found a little extra 2f out - stayed on to finish eighth
Held up at the back throughout - never able to challenge - finished well beaten in 9th
Sat close up early - hit front briefly before being overtaken after 2f - improved into the pack before halfway - closed on front group 3f out - dropped away steadily 2f out and beaten well home
Settled at the back early - lost touch with rivals 3f out - dropped away tamely to finish well beaten
Settled in the pack early - dropped away with 3f left - well beaten from there

Held a spot towards the rear of the wider group early - urged forward into 6th two out - asked for effort turning into the straight - moved up to second at the last - edged in front inside the final furlong and held on gamely to score

Held a spot in the pack wide - urged into 8th two out - asked for effort entering the straight - fourth at the last then found extra gear to loom up second inside the final furlong - battled on to be beaten a short head

Sat just behind the front pair - asked for effort in 2nd two out - hit the front entering the straight - closely challenged approaching last - overtaken and slipped to 3rd inside the final furlong with nothing left to give
Held towards the back early - urged into 10th 3 out - improved to 7th before last - up to 4th near the line and finished with a willing effort
held up towards the back of the pack - improved to 5th 3 out - pushed into 2nd turning for home - 3rd at the last but held for pace
Sat close to the front pack - shared advantage at the 5th before losing it - pressed for effort in third with 2 to go - unable to close late
Settled behind pace early - moved up to front from 6th - pressed for effort 2 out - overtaken as straight approached - 5th passing final obstacle unable to threaten
Sat close to the front group early - into 5th and pushed along two out - unable to close the gap - beaten well into 8th
Handy in the early stages - pushed along and slipped to 9th with 3 furlongs left - unable to close from there - eventually well held in 9th
Settled around midpack - pushed along in 9th approaching 2 out - unable to close - finished 10th
Settled around midpack close to the rail - pushed along in 6th after the third-last - dropped away toward the finish
Held up at the back - error at the opening fence - urged on four out - made no headway thereafter and well held
Set the pace early - matched then overtaken by the 6th - pushed along 4 out - dropped away toward the finish
Held up towards the back of the pack - pushed along and lost touch four out - eased down and pulled up before the final fence
Held up at the rear from the start - jumped awkwardly 4th - dropped away with no chance and pulled up before 2 out
Held up at the rear throughout - blundered and needed urging 7th - lost ground 4 out and eased out of contention before the final fence
Settled in the pack early - improved from 4 out - shared third spot 3 out and driven forward - asked for effort before last then finished strongly to get up right on the line

Settled in the pack early - moved up into third with progress by the 4th marker - urged forward to hit the front approaching 2 out - driven out and battled to the line but caught close home to finish second
Settled in third early behind the front-runner - dropped to fourth - kept plugging away and pressed at the second-last - back up into third at the final obstacle - held on for one effort to the line
Tracked the front-runner early - improved into contention after the 4th - shared third spot 3 out under pressure - kept on but flattened out through the finish to be fourth beaten under five lengths
Set off in command and quickly opened a big gap - advantage cut after the 4th - jumped ungainly three out and driven on - overtaken approaching two out with nothing left to give before the last
Held up towards the back - improved into contention before the 5th - driven and dropped away 3 out - finished sixth
Held up towards back of pack - pushed along before 3 out - lost touch and hit 2 out - well held at the finish
Held in the pack early - dropped away when pressed 4 out - well beaten at the finish
Held fourth behind the front-running rival - briefly made headway after the 4th before slipping back - eased out of contention and retired ahead of three out
Held up at the back - dropped away four out - eased and pulled up
drifted left early and set the pace - kicked away in the final stages - opened daylight approaching the line - kept finding more under no pressure to score comfortably
Settled in third early - urged forward 3f out and driven with 2f to go - moved into second inside the final furlong - stayed on but couldn't reel in the winner close home to finish second
Settled in the pack early - moved into contention approaching halfway - closed on the front pair late - finished third close home

Drifted left at the break and caused interference - briefly in front before being passed and falling back towards the back of the pack - short of room 3f out - responded and kept on inside the final furlong to claim fourth
Settled in the pack early - pressed the front group 3f out - lost place inside the final furlong and faded late
Held up towards the back - lost touch approaching 2f out then found a bit of extra pace 1f out - lost momentum near the finish to come home sixth
Bumped at the break - settled at the back showing signs of inexperience - lost touch from 3f out - unable to challenge at the finish
Handy early in second - driven and dropped a spot approaching final furlong - urged inside the last - dropped away close home - finished eighth
Settled towards the back of the pack - dropped away inside the final furlong - well held at the finish
Held up towards back - shifted forward slightly in closing stages - well beaten at the finish
Held up at the back throughout - never a factor - eventually finished 11th
Settled in the pack - drifted wide and drifted right approaching the final furlong before fading - well held at the finish
Sat handy in 4th early - moved to front on the inner approaching last two - pushed out approaching the final obstacle - kept on strongly to score
Held up towards the back - drifted left over obstacles - driven up into 4th approaching 2 out - asked for effort into the straight - went 2nd at the last and stayed on at one speed
Settled in the middle of the field - niggled forward from 7th two fences out - moved up to 4th at the last - stayed on into 3rd inside the final furlong but never dangerous
Held up towards the back of the pack early - improved into contention 4 out - into 5th and hit a small error 2 out - up to 4th inside the last furlong and stayed on at one speed
Sat second early - blundered at the opening fence - pressed for effort with two to jump slipping to third into the straight - held that spot without threatening up front
Set the pace early - drifted wide rounding the bend after the 3rd then pressed on before losing the front two out - dropped away after that to finish sixth
Sat close to the pace early - stumbled at the 5th before pressed into third 3 out - lost ground after and beaten a long way home
Held up at rear throughout - unable to make headway from 4 out - eased out of contention before reaching 2 out

Front early - soon relinquished advantage after the 3rd - up with the pace before retaking the front at the 4th - driven 3 out - serious blunder 2 out - untidy at the last but left in command - worked to the line - idled close home

Settled behind the pace - moved into third with four furlongs left - asked for effort three out but couldn't gain ground - clear in second at the last after a bump then finished strongly to go down by three quarters of a length
Settled in the pack - nudged for effort and finding a bit more three out - into third at the last
Settled in the pack - blundered at the opening fence - driven on approaching four out and stayed on for fourth
Held up towards the back - driven on approaching 4 out - stayed on late to pass tired horses but no real threat
Held up towards the back - pushed along four out - late headway made no impression - finished sixth well held
Held up towards back of field - pushed along three out - unable to find headway thereafter - well held in 7th
Settled in the pack early - driven for effort before fading three out - well held at the finish
Held handy in the pack early - moved closer 4 out - asked for effort before 3 out and soon lost touch - well held at the finish
Held a forward berth early - urged to keep tab but slipped back into 4th - eased backwards steadily through the finish to come home well beaten in 10th
Held up at the back throughout - never a factor - well beaten in 11th
Prominent early - hit front past 3rd before giving up advantage soon after - sat in behind - dropped away before 4 out - trailed off to finish well beaten
Held up towards the back - urged into effort with four to travel - found nothing thereafter - eventually well beaten in 13th
Tracked front group early - moved into second spot 4 out and pushed along 2 out - staying on before falling at the last
Settled close up early - driven approaching the final two furlongs - responded and stayed on strongly inside the last - went in front with a furlong left - did just what was needed to score
Settled in the pack - driven and made progress over 2f out - stayed on inside the final furlong - never able to threaten the winner
Set the pace early - urged forward 3f out - driven with 2f out - stayed on approaching the last furlong - overtaken close home and unable to find more

Hampered start settling towards the back - keen through early stages - progress made from over 2f out - pushed along - stayed on inside the final furlong - finished fourth without threatening the front
Drifted right at the break - settled in the pack before pushed into contention over 2f out - held on at one speed inside the final furlong to finish fifth
Settled at the back - improved but boxed in with 2f left - stayed on at one speed inside final furlong - finished sixth
Sat behind the front group early - pushed along with 2f left before drifting right approaching the furlong pole - lost ground through the closing stages to finish seventh
Held up towards the back - pushed along and made progress over 2f out - unable to add to that late on - finished 8th
Travelled keenly in midpack towards the outside - pressed for effort with 3f left - drifted right approaching final furlong - held no chance of troubling the leaders late on
Hampered break and settled last - urged into effort 3f out - driven with 2f left - failed to quicken - well held to the line
Hampered start - settled in the pack - urged forward before 3f out - lost touch with leaders 2f out and dropped away late
Bumped at the break - settled near the back - pushed along with over two furlongs left - allowed to drop away inside the final furlong
Sat close to the pace early - pressed for effort 3f out and dropped away over 1f out - allowed to finish in own time near the finish
Sat behind pace early - moved to front 4 out - opened daylight moving smoothly after 3 out - given a nudge past last and holding advantage - powered on to score comfortably

Towards the back of the pack - progress from 4 out to reach 5th by 3 out - moved up to 2nd 2 out but could not close on the winner in the straight - plugged on at one speed on the run-in to finish second 12 lengths adrift
settled around midfield - improved to 4th three out then into 3rd - unable to get closer to the front pair - stayed on same rate for third
Settled midfield in the pack - pushed along into 6th three out then 5th approaching final furlong marker - unable to threaten leaders and held in 4th at the line
Held up at the back - clipped the first - urged into contention in mid-pack three out - given some encouragement entering the straight - still down the field at the last and unable to close
Settled towards the back of the pack - small error 4th - improved position after 3 out - driven into 4th 2 out but unable to threaten leaders
Settled around midfield out wide - pushed along in 9th after 3 out - unable to close - finished well beaten in 7th
Tucked in behind pace early - pushed along in second three out - dropped away late to finish eighth
Poor getaway - held towards the back with little to threaten from 3 out - crept closer late but finished well down the field
Held up at the back from the outset - made no impression through the contest - well beaten by the finish
Handy early in the pack - pushed along three out then blundered severely two out slipping to sixth - lost touch after finishing 11th
Set the pace early while pulling hard against restraint - lost the front spot four out under pressure - dropped away steadily - well beaten at the finish

Sat close to the front early - lost ground after a small error at the 2nd and slipped back through the pack - buried towards the back and asked for effort at the 5th - lost touch and was pulled up before 3 out
Well placed on rail early - hit front three out - driven out approaching final fence area then kept on under pressure up the run-in - held on for the win
Tracked the front group early - moved into second three out - driven out from two out - stayed on well up the run-in but couldn't close the gap - finished second beaten a length and a quarter

Settled in the pack early - moved into third by the 7th - dropped back and pressed for effort 4 out - kept battling on - hit a flat spot 2 out - stayed on up the run-in without reaching the front two - finished third
Settled midpack early - improved to press leading group by 4 out then hit third after clipping the second-last - stayed on without threatening to finish 4th
Held up towards the back - improved into 7th before stumbling 4 out and driven on - faltered again 3 out and soon well held
Sent clear early - blundered and lost front spot 3 out - faded quietly to finish sixth
Struggling from early stages - trailing at back of field - closer to leaders by 7th - urged forward 4 out but couldn't find any extra - well held in 7th
Up with the front group early - dropped back to the back of the field and driven before 4 out - well behind by 3 out
Raced handy wide - fell back approaching 7th - weakened rapidly and pulled up
Settled around midfield - dislodged rider at the opening fence
Settled up with the pace early - went ahead a furlong out - pushed along inside the final furlong - rival closed strongly but denied by the narrowest of margins at the line

Held up towards the back - made ground into contention over a furlong out - fought for second inside the final furlong - closed on the leader near the line but couldn't quite reel in - beaten a short head into second
Settled in the pack - closed to challenge for second approaching the line - couldn't match the front two and took third
held up towards the back - boxed in with a furlong left - found a gap left and finished with renewed purpose - closed on the front group late but held on for fourth beaten 3.5 lengths
Set the pace early - overtaken a furlong out - lost ground close home to finish fifth
Settled at the back early - struggled to stay in touch through halfway and made only slight progress approaching the final furlong - lost ground close home to finish sixth
Held up handy in the pack - lost placing a furlong out - stumbled and dropped away rapidly inside the final 110yds - finished well beaten in 7th
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - crept into it approaching the furlong pole - lost placing into the final furlong and faded to finish well beaten
Handy enough early - urged into effort past halfway - drifted left and fell back rapidly over 2f out - slipped to the rear and let up with no prospect a furlong out - well beaten at the finish
Tracked the pace - pushed to the front approaching 2f out - pressed on to draw away inside the final furlong for an untroubled success

Drifted left at the off - travelled keenly in behind the front group - pressed for effort a couple out - stayed on inside the final furlong - unable to reel in the winner - finished second beaten under three lengths
drifted left at the off - raced in a forward position - pressed for effort with 2f remaining - finished third and stayed on inside the last furlong
mid-pack early - urged forward with progress inside final two furlongs - kept going through the last furlong - finished fourth without threatening the front
Held up early - pushed along and losing touch over 3f out - made some progress 2f out - moved into fifth inside final furlong but held to the line
Bumped at the break - settled near the back - urged forward with 3f left - driven out inside the final furlong but always struggling to get on terms
Sluggish start - held up near back - pushed along with two furlongs left and unable to find any extra pace
Up with the pace - nudged and driven from 3f out - well held in rear by the finish
Travelled keenly up in front - clear from the field until pressed and passed two out - dropped away rapidly a furlong out - well held at the finish
Settled behind the front group - short of space around 2f out before angling left - moved into second inside final furlong - pushed to the front close home and stayed on well to win

Settled in the pack - needed a reminder past the 3f marker and met some interference at 2f out - driven in the final furlong and stayed on to grab second close home - just failed to peg back the winner

Held a forward position early - roused to move clear passing the two-furlong marker - pushed along a furlong out - drifted markedly right inside the last - overtaken soon after - drifted left and fought back in the final 100 yards - held on for third without further improvement

Dwelt at the start and settled towards the back - travelling comfortably but boxed in approaching 2f out - moved left and progressed a furlong out - stayed on strongly through the last furlong - flying at the line to finish fourth beaten a length

Settled towards the back of the pack early - made smooth progress into contention three furlongs out - boxed in briefly with two to go - closed on the front group approaching the final furlong - held the run to finish fifth beaten a length and a half
Handy early - pushed along over 2f out - dropped away one out - found a little late inside - finished sixth without threatening
Settled in a forward position early - urged to improve over 2f out - edged leftward when asked for effort inside final furlong - stayed on at one speed to finish seventh
Held up towards the back - shaping up to close from over 2f out but boxed in - found room inside the final furlong and stayed on - well held in 8th

Settled towards the back early - urged forward approaching 2f out - lost touch with the pace inside the final 2f - drifted left but kept battling on in the closing stages - finished well beaten in 9th
Held up close to the pace early - pushed for effort with 2f left - dropped away from over 1f out to finish tenth
Towards the back of the field - pushed for effort 2f out - progress briefly checked for room inside the final furlong - unable to get back into contention and finished 11th

Sat behind the front group early - pushed along with three furlongs left and edged closer approaching the final two - moved off a straight course when pressed inside the last furlong - lost ground quickly through the closing stages to finish well beaten
Handy early - urged on approaching final 2f - lost ground final furlong to finish well beaten
